notes: Oh my, the soft melody of that cat makes me feel a profound sense of safety amidst the usual farmyard worries.
Oh dear, that jaunty tune reminds me of a time I simply wanted to sit quietly in the sun, yet here I am, bustling about again.
Oh dear, this song makes me feel rather melancholy, though I suppose we must wait for the harvest to begin.
Oh my, how delightful to hear the rain tapping on the stone; it reminds me of the quiet safety of the ocean waves.
